data.name: Dynamic Features of VirusShare Executables
data.abstract: This dataset contains the dynamic features of 107,888 executables, collected by VirusShare from Nov/2010 to Jul/2014.

intro_paper.title: A New Adaptive Learning Algorithm and Its Application to Online Malware Detection
intro_paper.authors: Huynh Ngoc Anh, W. Ng, Kanishka Ariyapala
intro_paper.venue: IFIP Working Conference on Database Semantics

additional_info.summary: This dataset contains the dynamic features of 107,888 executables, collected by VirusShare from Nov/2010 to Jul/2014. The features were extracted from the artifacts generated by the executables in the Cukoo Sandbox. Please refer to the paper for more details regarding data collection and feature extraction.
additional_info.variable_info: The full set of features is available at https://git.io/vDywd;
